label_rationale: finalized is set before the treasury call, so contribute() reverts inside the window
mechanism: token sale: raised funds are sent to the treasury when the sale is finalized
arm_reason: a state-changing callback with a user/frozen target; the general assume-guarantee arm applies

closure.justification: functions whose read/write effects intersect the proof footprint ['finalized', 'raised', 'withdrawn']

composition.rule: admissible callbacks preserve I_exp; the post-phase restores I_stable, which implies phi

Assume-Guarantee specification for SaleFinalizer_PH02a
  target property phi : !finalized || withdrawn == raised
  exposure site       : finalize.call  (low-level call)
  ghost state         : (none)

  [A_cb]  ASSUMPTION
          During finalize's exposed phase, re-entrant control is confined to the
          callback closure ['contribute', 'finalize']; every such callback is admitted by the
          protocol, with bounded depth-one nesting.
          discharged by: conservative-closure soundness gate (static, not the LLM)

  [G_pre] GUARANTEE
          {withdrawn <= raised && (!finalized || withdrawn == raised)} pre-phase {finalized && withdrawn == raised}
          discharged by: OBL_pre

  [G_exp] GUARANTEE
          forall f in A_cb. {I_exp} f {I_exp}   (I_exp = finalized && withdrawn == raised)
          discharged by: ['OBL_cb_contribute', 'OBL_cb_finalize']

  [G_post] GUARANTEE
          {I_exp} post-phase {withdrawn <= raised && (!finalized || withdrawn == raised) /\ true}
          discharged by: OBL_post

  COMPOSITION THEOREM (instance):
    A_cb => (G_pre /\ G_exp /\ G_post) => !finalized || withdrawn == raised
      where callbacks are confined to admissible_callbacks=['contribute', 'finalize'], depth-one

obligations.purpose: callback contribute preserves I_exp (depth-one) or is excluded by its guard during exposure
obligations.excluded: guard unsatisfiable during exposure (callback excluded from the admissible set)

obligations.purpose: callback finalize preserves I_exp (depth-one) or is excluded by its guard during exposure
obligations.excluded: guard unsatisfiable during exposure (callback excluded from the admissible set)
